message: 改良の余地あり

name: Ria
message: 「Sorry to drag you along, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't mind at all. If it's related to the Crusaders, I want to see it too」
After school, Ria-senpai invited me out, and we came down to the wharf.

name: Ria
message: 「My big sister built a mothership for us」

name: Synn
message: 「You mean like a mobile base from a kids' sentai hero show?」

name: Ria
message: 「Uh, umm... She told me to wait here, so I think it's just a normal cruiser, though...」

name: Ria
message: 「Knowing my big sister, right? Today, you're my knight, Synn-kun\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes, I'll do my best」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'm jealous. I'm strictly the Great Sage... It's gotta be Sir Synn as the knight, y'know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Something's coming from across the sea...」
A pink dot appears on the horizon.
Kicking up a spray of water, the dot rapidly expands into a familiar shape... that of Tontoro, though on a completely different scale.
Its underbelly somewhat resembles a hovercraft, and the roar of high-speed propellers can be heard, so it seems to obey the laws of physics, at least on paper.

name: Ria
message: 「Aha, ahahaha... That's gotta be it, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, that's some insane tech, but isn't its movement looking kinda sketchy?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, it can't seem to kill its momentum and looks like it's wobbling」

name: Ria
message: 「I-Is my sister going to be okay?」

name: Ria
message: 「Kyaa!? It ran aground」
Tilting slightly to one side, the giant Tontoro runs up onto the jetty and comes to a complete stop.
Almost at the same time, its mouth opens, and Helena-san and Riesling-san step out from inside.

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, it's your mischievous Chairwoman Helena\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Big sister, you're going way too wild!」

name: Riesling
message: 「I am humbled」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nobody was complimenting you, y'know?」

name: Synn
message: 「*Fidget, fidget*...」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Synn-kun? Don't tell me you actually want to ride it?」

name: Synn
message: 「B―But I've never seen a hovercraft before, so I just―」

name: Riesling
message: 「No, it is not a hovercraft, it is an Ojoucraft. Please do not mistake the two」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, Synn-chan. I understand your excitement, but it's off-limits. Today is just the unveiling」

name: Riesling
message: 「We managed to dock somehow, yet there are issues with the braking, rendering it unfit for delivery」

name: Riesling
message: 「The noise is also severe, making it unsuitable for covert operations... There is an abundance of room for improvement」

name: Helena
message: 「Geez, Tamiko-chan. You don't have to say it so bluntly, you know」

name: Helena
message: 「Still, we're going to keep researching. With the Kujou and Rosenkreuz families forming a technical alliance, nothing is impossible」

name: Riesling
message: 「Yes. By utilizing its near-zero coefficient of friction, taking off with an extremely short runway in the future is no mere dream」

name: Synn
message: 「An all-purpose Tontoro for land, sea, and air?! T-That's amazing!」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Synn-kun, your eyes are starting to look just like Lolotte-chan's?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Excuse me, a phone call from the Master...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Hello, this is the young lady's butler, Riesling Tooyama, speaking」

name: Riesling
message: 「Fried rice vermicelli? I shall hasten there at once」

name: Riesling
message: 「Helena. Urgent official business has arisen, so I shall take my leave here」

name: Helena
message: 「Tamiko-chan, bye-bye♪」

name: Helena
message: 「Now then, since the unveiling ceremony is over, let's go have some tea」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis... is it really okay to just leave the big Tontoro-chan here like this?」

name: Helena
message: 「The young guys from the Second-Generation Takahashi Group are coming to pick it up, so no need to worry about that! Come on, you two, I'll show you a great place」

name: Synn
message: 「...? 'Young guys'?」
Led along by Helena-san, Ria-senpai and I drank Japanese tea at a strange restaurant.
When we stopped by Tsukinowo Park on the way home, the Ojoucraft had vanished without a trace.
